actual_checks: Read exact official P-vs-NP prompt and all three retained prior bodies(A1,A2 and alias TOP-3395-A1). Verified incidence-decomposition coverage/connectedness validation and the explicit distinction from primal width and clause arity.

Checked the exact state invariant: s(c) counts only satisfied literals of variables forgotten below. Introduced clauses cannot have forgotten neighbors below; forgetting variables ORs contributions, and forgetting clauses checks both saved and still-bag contributions. Every clause neighbor is then accounted for by decomposition connectedness.

At joins, shared variable assignments agree, forgotten sets are disjoint and clause bits OR exactly; child witnesses combine in both directions. Empty root accepts iff all clauses satisfied; backpointers reconstruct a direct-checkable assignment. Empty clauses/tautologies/repeats are handled.

Verified2^(t+1) states, join pairs<=2^|V|4^|C|<=4^(t+1), polynomial encoding/backpointer costs and t=O(log L) supplied-decomposition consequence. No decomposition for arbitrary formulas or global P=NP claim; source/proof-only zero runs.

prior_work_distinction: Adds a complete clause-width-independent incidence-treewidth algorithm and exact joins, distinct from all three prior affine-summary/rank/projection investigations. This is substantive structural tractability, not a finite SAT experiment.
scope_assessment: Given a CNF formula and a verified nice tree decomposition of its variable–clause incidence graph of width t with b bags, satisfiability and one witness are computed in O(b·4^(t+1)·poly(L)) bit time, where L is the full formula/decomposition encoding. Clause width is unrestricted. This is an explicit structural subclass, not a uniform polynomial bound for all NP verifiers.
